name: Silvervein the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, travelers find Silvervein the Elder on the hills above Thelsamar in Loch Modan. They honor him and the ancient ties among Azeroth’s elder peoples, and he grants them an ancestral blessing.

sections.title: A Vigil Over Thelsamar
sections.body: Above Thelsamar, Silvervein keeps watch as travelers honor him. He holds memories from ages past. Though trogg invasions and local disputes trouble Loch Modan, the elder spirit remains peaceful on his overlook.

sections.title: Honoring the Olden Races
sections.body: Silvervein welcomes travelers who honor Azeroth’s olden races. His greeting carries ancestral appreciation. To those who pay homage, he offers a commemorative token.

faq.answer: Silvervein is an ancestral spirit who appears during the Lunar Festival. He spends the festival atop the high bluffs near Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Silvervein?
faq.answer: Silvervein waits on a grassy hill overlooking Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

faq.q: What is the purpose of seeking out Elder Silvervein?
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, travelers seek Silvervein to honor the ancestors and ancient races. He gives them a festive token and an ancestral blessing.

faq.q: What does he mean by 'the olden races'?
faq.answer: The olden races are Azeroth’s ancient peoples, who lived and shaped the world long before modern conflicts took center stage. Their heritage endures.

faq.q: Is Elder Silvervein friendly to Horde travelers?
faq.answer: Yes. Silvervein welcomes peaceful travelers of every background who come during the Lunar Festival to honor the ancestors.

faq.q: Does Elder Silvervein have any connection to the trogg invasion?
faq.answer: No. Trogg incursions and excavator troubles trouble Loch Modan, but Silvervein remains apart from local military conflicts and focused on honoring the ancestors.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can honor your shared ancient history with Silvervein near Thelsamar.
As an Alliance traveler in Loch Modan, you can climb the ridge above Thelsamar and honor the ancient dead between trogg hunts.
